supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: extension visible beyond the outer orbital margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high intensity contrast between pale/pink muzzle and dark grey/mottled periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick and prominent vertical droop visible

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: extensive pink depigmentation on the nose and central muzzle
other_distinctive_markers: digit or foreign object placement within the oral cavity
